BiblicalUsage: 1) to break, break in pieces; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) break, break in or down, rend violently, wreck, crush, quench; 1a2) to break, rupture (fig); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be broken, be maimed, be crippled, be wrecked; 1b2) to be broken, be crushed (fig); 1c) (Piel) to shatter, break; 1d) (Hiphil) to cause to break out, bring to the birth; 1e) (Hophal) to be broken, be shattered
